name: app-crypto-swap-screen-with-floating-detail-cards
title: Coin swap screen with hand and floating enlarged input cards on a pearl gradient
whatItIs: A pale grey pearl gradient with a large headline whose last words are faded grey. A hand holds a phone showing a swap screen; two large enlarged cards (You Pay BNB, You Receive USDT) float out on thin connector lines, with small captions and glyph icons.
whatItMeans: Clear and refined; the enlarged fields make the key interaction easy to understand.
techniques: Enlarge important UI fields as floating cards connected by thin lines.
Fade part of the headline to grey for emphasis.
Use a pearly grey gradient background.
Set numerals in a light serif.

vocabulary.definition: A thin line linking a callout to its source.
A magnified UI component beside the device.
